meta.title: Simple History – Track, Log, and Audit WordPress Changes
meta.author: Simple-History
meta.description: Try Simple History with a pre-seeded activity log. Posts, pages, comments and user events are spread across the last 30 days so the log and the History Insights charts have real data to show.
